output.reason_for_conversation: understanding medication risks to make informed treatment decision
output.summary: User considering starting a biologic for psoriasis was anxious about cancer and infection risks after reading online. The bot provided structured education on relative versus absolute risk, explained differences between TNF inhibitors, IL-17 inhibitors, and IL-23 inhibitors, and helped the user recognise that risk assessment must be personalised to their medical and family history. By the end the user had reframed the decision as a balance between drug risks and untreated disease risks, and felt equipped to have an informed conversation with their dermatologist.
